existing_tips: Swedish verbs ending in -s can be passive or deponent (active meaning). Context determines which.
'Hoppas' (to hope) – deponent verb ending in -s but with active meaning.
"Andas" is deponent – always has -s but is active in meaning (to breathe).
"Brottas" = wrestle. Reciprocal – they wrestle each other.
"Överraskande" (surprising) – present participle (-ande/-ende) never inflects. Same for all forms.
